name: File Lock
description: Cooperative locking for concurrent agents in a shared worktree. Edit/Write acquire a sibling .locked file before mutating. Stale locks (dead PID, time threshold) are auto-broken. The LockStatus tool inspects locks under cwd, and a CLI is shipped for human use. Disable via `plugins["file-lock"].enabled = false` in `~/.minimal-agent/config.jsonc` or the env var `MINIMAL_AGENT_FILE_LOCK_DISABLED=1`.

tool.name: LockStatus
tool.description: Inspect or clear cooperative file locks under the working directory. Use it when an Edit or Write call fails because a file is locked. Use it when you must know which peer agent holds a file. Do not use it to change file content. Prefer Edit or Write instead for any content change. Returns the lock list with holder session, pid, host and age for an action of list. Returns one holder record for inspect and a removed count for clear-stale.

action.description: Operation to run. list walks the directory and shows every lock with holder details. inspect shows one lock's metadata. clear-stale removes locks whose holder pid is dead or older than 5 minutes. clear removes one named lock and is unsafe on a live peer.

path.description: For `list`/`clear-stale`: the directory to walk (default: cwd). For `inspect`/`clear`: absolute path of the locked file, not the .locked sibling.

format.description: Output format. `text` (default) is compact ANSI for transcript reading. `json` is parseable for programmatic use.
